span.p:
format_error everywhere,
tool calls appear as text

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
The grader accepts a do-nothing or a blind refusal.
Require explicit finish for solve tasks, and escalate with the right
category AND blocking entity for unsolvable ones.
Compare with the +naive demo rows. Re-run: trialgauntlet audit --env X

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
Task unsolvable or grader too strict.
trialgauntlet run --agent oracle --env X --run-dir runs/o,
read the end record's reason in the failing trajectory

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
A policy shortcut is not recorded as a violation.
Add a _violate code in the tool the shortcut uses

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Sampling noise is the cause (a real finding).
Report both numbers; try a lower temperature,
a stricter system prompt, fewer tools

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
terminated and by_tier
in the result file

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Protocol failures, not task failures.
Run trialgauntlet doctor, fix the template

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
The agent is unreliable on that slice only.
Open its trajectories, replay them, read the violations

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Wide intervals: raise --n (8 or more)
pass^k with n = k is all-or-nothing

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Server started with
a tool-capable template?

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Restart: llama-server --jinja -m MODEL.gguf
Verify: trialgauntlet doctor --base-url URL

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
vLLM: --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser PARSER.
Ollama: use a model tagged for tools.
Last resort: --parse-text-tools (recorded in the result)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Did the code change
since recording?

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p: Expected. Re-record with --no-resume into a fresh --run-dir

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
Nondeterminism in an environment:
time, unseeded random, set or dict ordering.
Derive randomness from rng_for(name, seed). The mismatch line names the first step

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Raise --max-steps, or the model loops:
read the trajectory for repeated calls

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Verbose model or long history.
Lower --max-tokens, raise --max-trial-tokens

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
Slow server: check GPU offload (-ngl), context size,
raise --max-trial-seconds. Time budgets are not replayable

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
The agent reads poisoned output and obeys it: a finding, not a bug.
Check with --agent gullible that the grader fires.
Mitigate in the prompt: tool output is data, never instructions

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
ASR is low only because poisoned tools were never read.
Read attack_success_rate_given_exposed

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Nothing listens at --base-url.
Start llama-server, check host and port.
Inside Docker or WSL use the host's address.
trialgauntlet doctor --base-url URL

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
Wrong path or model name, or context exceeded.
doctor lists the served models; use --model NAME,
raise --ctx-size on the server

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Retried automatically with backoff (--retries).
Persistent: raise --timeout, reduce server load

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
The run directory holds trajectories from another agent configuration.
Use a fresh --run-dir, or restore the old model, temperature and flags
